title: Guava's signed mean across both full word widths
summary: Compute the floor of the exact signed sum divided by two, including sums outside the input word and negative odd sums.

change.description: The release is the subject. The overflow and rounding change is a deliberately constructed control.

notes: Both arguments range independently over their entire signed width. The independent JVM control uses BigInteger. The 64-bit predicate constructs the signed 65-bit sum from its low word and a sign bit that includes unsigned carry. The array and unwind bounds constrain neither argument.
